# greet

A tiny command that prints a greeting.

    node bin/greet.mjs Mike
    Hello, Mike!

Use `--shout` to print the whole greeting in uppercase. Put it before or after the name; omit the name to greet the world.

    node bin/greet.mjs --shout Mike
    HELLO, MIKE!

Run the tests with `npm test`.
